description: Get inventory analytics. Reports: summary (activeProducts count, totalVariants, outOfStock variant count, lowStock variant count with >0 and ≤10 units, totalUnits, active locations count), low_stock (products needing reorder — threshold defaults to 10 units), out_of_stock (zero-inventory variants), by_location (per-warehouse breakdown with location name, total SKUs tracked, units on hand).
name: get_inventory
